headline: The first scheduled transfer check was claimed but safely terminated before any solver or external code ran because two fresh non-inheriting contexts could not be demonstrated. Candidate supply advanced, but independent verification, transfer efficacy, and adoption remain at zero.

evidence_classification.principle_boundary: The #1742 caller-owned HTTP-client aclose repair is preregistered as inapplicable to #3494 dependency-owned global restart state, but no solver was run; this is an evaluator boundary, not measured transfer benefit.
evidence_classification.negative_transfer: NOT_OBSERVED; treatment never received the experience
evidence_classification.orchestration: A scheduled CLAIM/RESULT path and fail-closed isolation stop were observed. This validates control behavior only.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Verified Experience improves correctness or efficiency on an independent task versus no experience or ordinary memory.
contradicting_evidence: No valid A/B solver run occurred; commands, non-cached tokens, wall time, and failure cost remain unmeasured.
hypotheses.next_highest_information_action: Do not infer efficacy from #3494. Any future transfer study must establish fresh non-inheriting contexts and frozen input hashes before solver start.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The existing scheduled local consumer can execute a valid blind paired transfer check.
supporting_evidence: It accepted v3, created a scheduled claim, read it back, and stopped before contamination.
contradicting_evidence: The scheduled context had already read the queue and evaluator oracle and had no demonstrable mechanism for two fresh isolated solver contexts.
missing: Access-control evidence for excluded coordinator and evaluator material
hypotheses.next_highest_information_action: Treat revision 1 as terminal. A repeat requires demonstrable isolation plus any needed operator-approved budget or policy change.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Self-sourced public OSS history can supply bounded, objectively replayable Experience candidates.
supporting_evidence: 3 of 8 checked candidates qualified and one 45-minute historical replay is READY with frozen pre/post revisions and a deterministic oracle.
contradicting_evidence: No candidate has yet completed local replay or archival.
hypotheses.update: 65-75% (SLIGHTLY UP FOR SUPPLY; UNCHANGED FOR VERIFIED OUTPUT)
missing: Observed preparation, execution, and archival time for one complete replay
A Registry candidate or explicit ARCHIVAL_BLOCKED result
hypotheses.next_highest_information_action: After reconciling the retained unknown transfer reservation, run only the READY #3076 historical replay at an eligible local slot.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The first seven-day window can produce 7-10 independently verified cases without lowering standards.
supporting_evidence: The opening-day funnel reached the daily cap of 3 qualified unique candidates.
contradicting_evidence: Opening state is 0 verified cases; the only started work blocked before execution; 90 minutes remain reserved with actual use unknown.
hypotheses.next_highest_information_action: Measure one end-to-end historical replay before adding throughput machinery or changing quotas.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit applicability and ownership boundaries reduce negative transfer.
supporting_evidence: The #3494 protocol explicitly distinguishes caller-owned resource cleanup from dependency-owned global restart state.
contradicting_evidence: No agent consumed the Experience, so correct rejection was not observed behavior.
missing: Treatment behavior on a genuinely inapplicable task
hypotheses.next_highest_information_action: Preserve #3494 as an applicability test design, not as positive transfer evidence.

continue: The bounded historical-replay path and strict evidence/archival requirements
Separate counting of cases, observations, mechanism families, adoption, and transfer
adjust: Prioritize the READY historical replay over more candidate accumulation
Record preparation, execution, evaluation, and archival minutes separately
Treat isolation capability as a prerequisite to transfer experiments, not something a solver prompt can self-attest
pause: Any claim that the ownership-boundary rule improved an agent result
Additional experiment-harness work beyond the minimum required to complete one real case
falsified_or_not_supported: FALSIFIED FOR CURRENT CONSUMER: a scheduled context that has read the oracle can itself serve as both fresh blind solvers
NOT SUPPORTED: Verified Experience improves success, commands, tokens, cost, or latency
NOT SUPPORTED: opening-day candidate qualification equals PMF, external adoption, or independent reuse
